description: This file is a utility class for handling PDU (Protocol Data Unit) parsing related to SMS content, specifically checking for Content-Disposition header support using the SmsManager API.

classes.name: PduParserUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing method to determine support for Content-Disposition headers in SMS messages.

methods.name: shouldParseContentDisposition
methods.description: Returns whether the device supports parsing the Content-Disposition header in MMS messages, based on carrier configuration.
